content.comment_body: I'm configuring a yearly timer through the [product_name] Web Editor software. When setting up the timer, the month field correctly accepts values from 1–12, but the day field only allows values from 1–12 as well. Attempting to set the day above 12 keeps the previous value unchanged—if I set the date to 12-5 it works, but changing it to 5-13 only updates the month and leaves the day at 5. Not sure what I'm missing.
Which [product_name] Web Editor version are you using?
Please upload your [product_name] Soft Comfort program and your [product_name] Web Editor project in a zip archive.
[product_name] Web Editor version 1.1 and [product_name] Soft Comfort V8.3. Program should be attached.

Apologies for the delayed response. There is an overlap issue in your Parameter VM Mapping. The addressing for [product_name] controllers is byte-based. The spacing for word addresses is 2, and for double word addresses it's 4.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unable to configure the yearly timer feature in [product_name] Web Editor: while month selection works, setting the day above 12 always fails and only the previous value is kept. Another user identifies a technical issue within VM Parameter Mapping and explains that the [product_name] controller uses byte-oriented addressing, which may be contributing to this problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to set any valid day within a month when configuring the yearly timer in [product_name] Web Editor, not just days 1–12, and wants edits to the timer to update the date fields as intended.
